milestones.demo: Deploy a project declared with one [deploy.services.app] (source=build, port=3000, url='example.com') end-to-end: build → image pushed → compose rendered with /healthz healthcheck and .env.app → app up on Caddy. Migration from legacy [deploy.image] to the new per-service schema for the simplest case.

tasks.title: Replace deploy.image with deploy.services record in types
tasks.done_when: HetznerVpsDeploySection carries services: Record<string, UserServiceConfig>; DeployImageConfig removed from the deploy section; tsc passes.
tasks.description:
WHAT — Introduce UserServiceConfig = ServiceCommon & (BuildServiceConfig | UpstreamServiceConfig), discriminated on `source`. ServiceCommon = { port?: number, url?: string, secrets?: string[], needs?: string[], depends_on?: string[] }. BuildServiceConfig = { source: 'build', context?, dockerfile?, target? }. UpstreamServiceConfig = { source: 'upstream', ref, registryAuthSecret? }. Drop `image: DeployImageConfig` from HetznerVpsDeploySection; replace with `services: Record<string, UserServiceConfig>`. Keep CloudflarePagesDeploySection untouched.

WHY — D1 + D2: the new TOML schema flattens per-service config under [deploy.services.<name>] and pushes image config to be per-service via a discriminated union; greenfield framing (no legacy [deploy.image] kept).

WHERE — packages/infrastructure/src/config/types.ts

DONE WHEN —
- HetznerVpsDeploySection no longer carries `image`; instead `services: Record<string, UserServiceConfig>`
- BuildServiceConfig + UpstreamServiceConfig types exported; discriminated union on `source`
- pnpm typecheck succeeds (downstream call sites broken on purpose — fixed in tasks 02-08)

tasks.title: Validate [deploy.services.<name>] section with source discriminator
tasks.done_when: validateDeploySection walks [deploy.services.*] sub-tables, enforces the source discriminated union, rejects legacy [deploy.image] residual, requires at least one service.
tasks.description:
WHAT — Replace validateImage with validateServices in validation/deploy.ts. For each sub-table under [deploy.services.<name>]: validate KEBAB instance name; parse ServiceCommon (port default 3000, url optional, secrets array, needs array, depends_on array); switch on `source`. For 'build': context/dockerfile/target optional with defaults (target defaults to service name); reject ref/registry_auth_secret. For 'upstream': require non-empty ref; reject context/dockerfile/target. Reject any [deploy.image] field with a 'migrate to [deploy.services.<name>]' message. Require at least one service. In M1 only, also reject more than one — temporary, lifted in M2.A-01. Wire the new shape through providers/hetzner.ts so it lands in HetznerVpsDeploySection.

WHY — D1 + D2: the parser is the gate between raw TOML and typed config; the discriminated union must be enforced at parse time so the rest of the codebase consumes a clean shape.

WHERE — packages/infrastructure/src/config/validation/deploy.ts; packages/infrastructure/src/config/validation/providers/hetzner.ts; packages/infrastructure/src/config/fixtures

DONE WHEN —
- Fixture [deploy.services.app] with source=build → parses; port defaults to 3000
- Fixture source='build' + ref → error 'ref forbidden when source=build'
- Fixture source='upstream' without ref → error 'ref required when source=upstream'
- Fixture with residual [deploy.image] → error pointing at [deploy.services.<name>]
- Fixture with zero [deploy.services.*] → error 'at least one [deploy.services.*] required'
- Fixture with two [deploy.services.*] → error (M1 stub; relaxed in M2)

tasks.title: Emit per-service image_refs JSON from compute-image-ref
tasks.done_when: compute-image-ref writes bake_targets CSV + image_refs JSON Record<service, ImageRef> to GITHUB_OUTPUT; legacy image_ref single output removed.
tasks.description:
WHAT — Iterate config.deploy.services. For each service with source='build', compute ImageRef as ghcr.io/<owner>/<repo>-<service>:<sha> (reuse computeImageRef with the service suffix). For each service with source='upstream', parse service.ref through parseImageRef. Emit two GITHUB_OUTPUT entries: `bake_targets='<csv of services with source=build>'` and `image_refs=<JSON Record<service, ImageRef>>`. Drop the legacy single `image_ref` output.

WHY — D4: a single multi-target bake needs the explicit list of build targets; downstream jobs (migrate, deploy) consume the full Record so compose render can map per-service refs.

WHERE — packages/infrastructure/src/cli/deploy/compute-image-ref.command.ts; packages/infrastructure/src/domain/deploy/image-ref.ts (extend computeImageRef with a service suffix arg)

tasks.description:
WHAT — In .github/workflows/deploy.yml: change the Build and push step `targets:` from the hardcoded `app` to `${{ steps.compute.outputs.bake_targets }}`. Build the `set:` block by mapping each entry of image_refs JSON to `<target>.tags=<ref>` (one bash line that iterates the JSON, or generated via the compute step itself if simpler — keep YAML free of logic per the package YAML-vs-TS rule). Replace IMAGE_REF env on the migrate + deploy jobs with IMAGE_REFS sourced from build-image.outputs.image_refs (and from plan outputs for the upstream-only path — see plan step).

WHY — D4: one bake run for N services keeps buildx cache shared and runner cost flat; downstream jobs consume the full Record so they know every service's ref.

WHERE — .github/workflows/deploy.yml

Existing backing groups (postgres, supabase) remain unchanged. M1 ships with a single user service in fixtures.

WHY — D2 (per-service image), D5 (per-service env file), D7 (mandatory /healthz healthcheck contract). Loop body is the foundation for M2 multi-service + M3 multi-instance.
